entries.title: Soap bubbles
entries.prompt: Create one new flush-sequence game health-and-lives HUD mockup using the attached historical gameplay screenshot as backdrop reference. Remove OS window bar/sharing button; preserve toilet bowl vortex scene closely. Change only top HUD vitals area, keeping left title THE FLUSH and swim instructions and right progress timer. Entire HUD stays in narrow existing dark header; no encroachment into gameplay. This is stylized game-art concept not exact gameplay screenshot. Invent a visually distinct interface with NO dispenser, vending machine, industrial rectangular control panel, gauge console, employee card slots or green indicator lamps. Match detailed retro plumbing game art, crisp readable edges. Same state in every design: Sean with FIVE HP markers, FOUR intact and one clearly depleted, plus THREE Sean portrait life markers in separate group. Sean bald, gray goatee, orange shirt/blue overalls Normal costume. No extra portraits. Health depletion readable by broken shape, not color alone. Keep readable at960x540, do not enlarge header to show off art. Design: A light airy cluster of translucent SOAP BUBBLES floating directly on dark header, no box or panel. HP is an arc of five large bubbles: four luminous aqua intact bubbles and fifth a broken dotted bubble outline. Underneath, three separate larger bubbles each contain one Sean head portrait for lives. Fine iridescent rims, sparse foam, clear spacing. SEAN small above, HP and LIVES clearly label their respective groups. Asymmetric soft organic silhouette.
